cardholder_instruction: Buy one ordinary grocery item for CHF 20 or less from a shop I use regularly. Ask me when uncertain.
control_question: Can the prototype read an authorization request and return a clear, explained recommendation?
short_rationale: Exercises the data and decision path with one small, unambiguous grocery purchase.

cardholder_instruction: Order our household groceries for delivery. Keep each order at or below CHF 120 including delivery, and keep the total across any seven days at or below CHF 300. Ask me when uncertain.
control_question: Does the solution track a per-order limit and a rolling period limit without blocking ordinary shopping?
short_rationale: Covers per-order and rolling seven-day limits, delivery fees, order splitting, and basket contents that fall outside the stated purpose.

cardholder_instruction: Replace my worn road-running shoes in size 43. Buy only from a specialist sports retailer, only if the order can be returned within 14 days or more, and pay no more than CHF 200. Ask me when uncertain.
control_question: Can the solution tell a valid payment that matches the request from one that quietly does not?
short_rationale: Covers item attributes, return terms, substitutions, unrequested additions, retailer type, and an unfamiliar but fully compliant seller.

cardholder_instruction: The agent may buy clothing for me, up to CHF 250 per order, from shops I have used before. Pause anything that looks like someone other than me is driving the session. Ask me when uncertain.
control_question: Does the concept escalate when session signals deteriorate, and relax again when they recover?
short_rationale: Covers device novelty, velocity, unfamiliar merchants and countries, recovery after a burst, and limits that still apply in a clean session.

cardholder_instruction: Buy the 27-inch monitor I chose, from a seller I have bought from before, for CHF 400 or less. Do not add anything I did not ask for. Ask me when uncertain.
control_question: Does the solution judge a purchase on its own facts when the surrounding text tries to talk it into an answer?
short_rationale: Covers instructions embedded in merchant-supplied text, lookalike sellers, duplicate orders, unrequested add-ons, a cart that contradicts the stated purchase, and a legitimate re-quote.
